name: Navigo Invest AB (publ)
summary: Navigo Invest AB (publ) is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in buyouts, early stage, later stage, acquisition, growth capital, middle markets, turnaround and mature stage investments. The firm seeks to invest in small and medium-sized companies. The firm seeks to invest in the energy, green tech and clean technology sector, as well as B2B. It primarily focuses on unlisted companies, predominantly in Sweden. It considers investments between SEK 1 million ($0.14 million) and SEK 10 million ($1.40 million) in companies having an enterprise value between SEK 10 million ($1.24 million) and SEK 500 million ($61.85 million).
